title: An early lead gets amplified
hook: Two stated cases: explore the initial condition in a stipulated popularity recurrence.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the initial condition in a stipulated popularity recurrence affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Level, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the initial condition in a stipulated popularity recurrence in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
